literal_meaning: গলা ধরে রাখা বা আটকে যাওয়া (throat being caught or held)
figurative_meaning_en: to have a scratchy or sore throat, feeling irritation as if something is stuck
example_sentences_in_bangla: বর্ষায় ঠান্ডা লাগায় তার গলা ধরেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He caught a sore throat due to the rainy season cold.
Eating unripe ol fruit caused a scratchy throat.
history: This idiom originates from the experience of eating unripe 'ol' (elephant apple) fruit, which causes throat irritation, serving as a folk warning in Bengali rural culture against consuming certain foods prematurely.
note: The idiom often warns against eating unripe fruits like ol, which can literally cause throat discomfort.
